title: HelperSessionIntentParams
description: Spends one target: the token it was minted onto, the access epoch and commit deadline the coordinator read at the same moment, and the key or text payload (nocx-6q1uh.6, spec §6.5). Interactive pane input uses the same owner and encoder without a screen target, but is still bound to the current access epoch.

token.description: The whole signed target session.target minted, presented back to spend it. Empty only for interactive controller input.

accessEpoch.description: The epoch the coordinator currently believes applies — checked again at the commit point against the session's live epoch, never trusted from the token alone (spec §7.2).

commitBy.description: An absolute deadline on the machine's shared monotonic clock (internal/monoclock.Now, nanoseconds). Refused commit_deadline at receipt if already passed, and refused again at the commit point if it passes while queued.

payload.description: The intent's own argument, raw bytes (base64 on the wire): the encoded key description sessionruntime's own key-event decoder reads for kind key, or the literal text to type for kind text.

interactive.description: When true, this is ordinary input from the pane controller; token must be empty and the access epoch is still enforced at receipt and commit.
